text:
Adele: Heads up — ATS webhook dropped a bunch of interviewer IDs this morning, some scorecards not linked. Anyone else seeing this?

Mike: Yep, saw it around 08:57. Rough count ~50 candidates with missing scorecards. Import log shows 502 from /webhook/scorecard-sync.

recruiting-bot: Alert: webhook_retry_queue size=120, oldest_retry=00:42:13

Sophia: Is this related to yesterday's schema change? I merged rename interviewer_id -> paneler_id in prod at ~03:40.

Adele: That would explain it. Backfill CSV uses old key.

Tara: I'm on it — adding compatibility for both keys in the webhook handler. Will push a hotfix in ~10m.

Mike: If we can, let's run a small safe backfill after the handler is patched. I can run dry-run first:

```
python scripts/repair_scorecards.py --candidates 12345,67890,24680 --dry-run
```

Sophia: Also noticed some interviewers lost access to the evalforms list in the training portal. Might be linked.

Adele: Priority is restore live scorecards. Training portal can wait ~2 hours but keep me posted.

Tara: Patch deployed to staging, accepting both interviewer_id and paneler_id. Running integration tests now.

recruiting-bot: Deploy status: staging succeeded at 09:21 UTC — tests: 14/14 passed

Mike: Cool — once staging green, schedule prod rollout with 5-min maintenance window? I'll coordinate comms.

Tara: Planning prod deploy 11:30 UTC. I'll add step to drain webhook queue and then run backfill. Posting runbook to #eng-oncall.

Adele: Please also update the onboarding doc and interviewer checklist link: <https://docs.internal/recruiting/interviewer-checklist|interviewer-checklist>

Sophia: Candidate-facing emails unaffected, confirmed.

Mike: I'll draft a quick async note for interviewers who lost eval access and include steps to re-link scorecards.

Adele: Thanks team — please ping here when backfill succeeds. I'll validate a sample of restored scorecards.
